The OptimUM-02 update builds on positive topline Exhibit 99.1 data reported in June showing treatment naïve HLA-A*02:01-negative patients receiving darovasertib plus crizotinib (the darovasertib combination) had a meaningful and statistically significant improvement in median progression free survival (PFS) compared to investigator’s choice of therapy as determined by both blinded independent central review (BICR) and investigator assessment.
